deck: PARCEL AUDITORS RERATE EVERY INVOICE LINE, FILE LATE-PACKAGE REFUND CLAIMS INSIDE 15 DAYS, AND ESCALATE DENIALS BY PHONE
CONTINGENCY RECOVERY ACROSS CARRIER, UTILITY, TELECOM, PROPERTY TAX, COST SEGREGATION, 179D, AND WOTC CLAIMS
site_ui.lead: Practitioners show how a package delivered even 60 seconds late earns a refund the carriers will never flag, how surcharges rather than base rates now drive parcel spend, and how auditors recover that money on contingency.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, from guaranteed-service refund recovery and surcharge rerating to property tax appeals, cost segregation, and the Work Opportunity Tax Credit. Every claim, metric, and quote carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner and video it came from.

flow: Take the client's online billing credentials and auto-download every carrier invoice to monitor shipping activity continuously
Rerate package by package with no sampling or average weights, checking 40 to 44 points per shipment against billable weight, DIM factors, and surcharge thresholds
Hold invoice payment and file guaranteed-service refund disputes inside the 15-day window, since a payment on file triggers automatic denials
Work denied claims through repeated resubmission and live phone agents, or choose an address correction dispute instead
Screen out automatic systematic SVC fail credits and require analyst sign-off on every figure before a dispute reaches the carrier
Charge only a contingent share of recovered savings, from 30 percent up to a 50 percent starting split, with no fee if nothing is saved
